note: Per table: which columns the Explore card reads as the record id, the entity, its type, the record's own subject, the year (and what year means there), the date, the amount and its basis, the source, supersession, and which columns make the one-line observation. Derived from the published sample's header by name, so PROPOSED; a table is `reviewed` only where data/cedar/explore.overrides.json declares it so, with its reason. Re-run after the importer copies samples.

contractors/prime_contracts.subject: awardee_name
contractors/prime_contracts._why: One row per contract transaction. reviewed 2026-09-05 from the sample header and its ten rows: total_award_value is cumulative and restated on every modification row (docs/MONEY_TOTALLING_RULES.md: NEVER SUM); obligations are the row's own money.

deals/deals_classified.subject: Native_Party
deals/deals_classified.entity_role: the Native party to the deal
deals/deals_classified._why: One row per announced deal. reviewed 2026-09-05 from the sample header and its ten rows: the amount is what was announced (Value_Type says what the figure is), not a verified consideration.

federal-register/consultation_events.subject: participant_name_as_published
federal-register/consultation_events.year_basis: calendar year of the notice date
federal-register/consultation_events._why: One row per consultation event and participant. reviewed 2026-09-05 from the sample header and its ten rows: most rows name no single entity, and the card says so rather than hiding them.

funding/federal_funding_transactions.subject: recipient_name
funding/federal_funding_transactions.entity_role: recipient, resolved to the Native entity behind it
funding/federal_funding_transactions._why: One row per USAspending assistance transaction. reviewed 2026-09-05 from the sample header and its ten rows: the fiscal year is the federal one, so an October action sits in the next year; negative obligations are de-obligations, kept as recorded. The source link is built from the award key on USAspending, the same pattern the subawards table records in its own source_url.

legislation/native_bills._why: One row per bill. reviewed 2026-09-05 from the sample header and its ten rows: a bill names several entities in one pipe-separated cell; the year is the introduced date's, and later actions have their own dates. The source link is the bill's congress.gov page, built from congress, bill type and number.

lobbying/native_entity_lobbying_disclosu.subject: client_name
lobbying/native_entity_lobbying_disclosu.entity_role: the registrant's client, resolved to the register
lobbying/native_entity_lobbying_disclosu.amount_label: spend, as reported by the registrant
lobbying/native_entity_lobbying_disclosu._why: One row per LDA filing. reviewed 2026-09-05 from the sample header and its ten rows: money is the registrant's reported income or expense (spend_basis says which); superseded filings stay as history and are hidden by default.

nagpra/nagpra_notices.subject: institution_name
nagpra/nagpra_notices.entity_role: culturally affiliated, as the notice determines
nagpra/nagpra_notices._why: One row per Federal Register NAGPRA notice. reviewed 2026-09-05 from the sample header and its ten rows: the record's subject is the holding institution; the Native entities are those the notice finds culturally affiliated (other roles, consulted and recipient, are in the record).

natural-resources/anc_ceiling_roster.year_basis: calendar year of row disposition date

natural-resources/resource_assets.year_basis: calendar year of first production date

natural-resources/resource_revenue.subject: recipient_entity_name
natural-resources/resource_revenue.year_basis: calendar year of the payment date
natural-resources/resource_revenue.amount_label: amount, as the source states it
natural-resources/resource_revenue._why: One row per revenue event. reviewed 2026-09-05 from the sample header and its ten rows: measurement_status says whether the amount is an actual payment or something else.

nest/nest_enterprises.subject: enterprise_name
nest/nest_enterprises._why: A register of enterprises, one row each, not events: no row date, so the year filter does not apply. reviewed 2026-09-05 from the sample header and its ten rows.

nonprofits/np_orgs.subject: org_name
nonprofits/np_orgs._why: A register of organizations, not events: no row date. reviewed 2026-09-05 from the sample header and its ten rows: source_url is the IRS BMF, the dataset's source, not a per-organization page.
nonprofits/np_orgs.entity_role: the tribe or Native entity the organization is linked to
nonprofits/np_orgs.amount_label: revenue in the IRS Business Master File

subcontracting/subawards.subject: sub_name
subcontracting/subawards.entity_role: the subawardee or prime's Native owner, resolved
subcontracting/subawards._why: One row per reported subaward. reviewed 2026-09-05 from the sample header and its ten rows.
